data.long_meaning: In ancient Greek culture, the name Xenos referred to a foreigner or a traveler. The root of the word comes from the Greek word 'xenos' which means 'guest' or 'stranger'. Xenos was also used in the New Testament to describe a Samaritan who helped a Jewish man in need. The name Xenos carries the meaning “Stranger, Foreigner” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
